response.sql:
WITH telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile,
    AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_modulation_index,
    AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg_modulation_index
  FROM signals
), above_average_groups AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM telescope_weather_groups AS g
  CROSS JOIN overall AS x
  WHERE g.avg_modulation_index > x.overall_avg_modulation_index
)
SELECT
  g.weathprofile,
  AVG(g.avg_modulation_index) AS avg_modulation_index,
  AVG(g.avg_phase_shift) AS avg_phase_shift,
  AVG(g.avg_modulation_index - x.overall_avg_modulation_index) AS avg_above_overall_modulation_index
FROM above_average_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN overall AS x
GROUP BY g.weathprofile;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average modulation index is calculated over all rows in signals, including signals without a matching telescope or observatory; the requested inner joins apply to the telescope/weather groups.
Each qualifying telescope/weather group contributes equally to the per-weather averages, regardless of how many signals are in the group.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the overall average only over signals that match to both a telescope and an observatory.
